headline: Cyclone Akvan: Odisha Evacuates Landslide Zones in 6 Districts

image.licence: Public domain (NASA EOSDIS GIBS / Worldview imagery, US government work)
image.author: NASA Worldview / EOSDIS GIBS, MODIS on the Terra satellite, morning pass of 16 Nov 2026
image.subject: Cyclone Akvan's cloud mass over the Bay of Bengal beside India's east coast (Andhra/south Odisha coast at upper left, Sri Lanka at lower left), 16 Nov 2026; bbox 3-19N, 77.6-90.4E. 17 Nov passes were not yet published on GIBS (blank tiles).

fact_sources.fact: Odisha collectors told to evacuate people from landslide-prone areas in Ganjam, Gajapati, Kandhamal, Rayagada, Koraput and Malkangiri and open relief centres
Ganjam collector Keerthi Vasan V: 107 pregnant women moved to safety; landslide-prone areas evacuated from Tuesday (17 Nov) morning
Minister Suresh Pujari: 74 teams, 60 ODRAF + 14 NDRF; focus on preventing landslide deaths
Cyclone Arnab killed at least 11 in Odisha (six missing), 10 of the deaths in landslides in Ganjam and Kandhamal
Fishermen advised not to venture into the sea 18-20 Nov (very rough sea)
Bhubaneswar Met Centre (Manorama Mohanty): orange (12-20 cm) and yellow (7-11 cm) warnings for Odisha districts 18-21 Nov; no red warning
IMD: Akvan to cross AP coast between Nellore and Tuni around noon 20 Nov as a very severe cyclonic storm
